insights.one_liner: European arm of Geely's premium electric car brand, based in the Amsterdam area, IND recognised sponsor, expanding into new European markets.

culture.text: Premium electric vehicle and tech brand owned by China's Geely Holding Group, aiming to speed up the shift to electric mobility.

open.text: ZEEKR EU B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a mid-level product and project role in the Amsterdam area, needs no Dutch; it drew 106 LinkedIn applicants on average.

growth.text: Announced four new European markets as its expansion continues.
Signed a distribution deal to launch in Poland in Q4.
Launched the 9X luxury SUV in Europe, widening its European range.

worth_knowing.text: Appointed a new chief commercial officer for the UK ahead of its launch there.
Named a new country manager for Belgium and Luxembourg, Dieter Hannes.
